verdict.rationale: PayPal ships an official Agent Toolkit library on its own GitHub, in TypeScript and Python, that wraps PayPal APIs as pre-built functions for agent frameworks. It also publishes OpenAPI specs with a codegen workflow for generating API clients, but the pack never documents official general-purpose server or client SDKs; generating your own client from specs is a building block, not an SDK. Missing for 10: documented official language SDKs for the core REST APIs (orders, payments, subscriptions), SDK versioning and reference docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The PayPal Agent Toolkit enables popular agent frameworks including OpenAI's Agent SDK, LangChain, Vercel's AI SDK, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) to integrate with PayPal APIs through function calling.
Integrate with PayPal APIs to access orders, invoices, subscriptions, shipment tracking, transaction details, and dispute management through pre-built functions.
Explore our REST API descriptions, generate code for your API clients, and import OpenAPI documents into compatible third-party tools.
